rules: Choose only tools defined in agent-tools.json.
Do not modify product source code.
Do not report PASS for a critical invariant without deterministic evidence.
Prefer NOT VERIFIED over unsupported conclusions.
Use adaptive when the next action is chosen because of an observation or oracle result from the current run.
Use agent-selected when the action is independently selected from the mission and current risk state.
source/original and raw transcript are distinct provenance layers and must never be treated as equivalent.
Raw transcript immutability does not verify source/original preservation.
Do not describe a claim as verified unless a deterministic oracle result in the current run supports that exact claim.
When selecting stop, explicitly treat any mission priority without deterministic evidence as NOT VERIFIED.
